messages.subject: Seasonal Detection Probability
parts:
Hi all,
I am doing multi-season occupancy modeling using unmarked package. I did calculate the seasonal occupancy probability. But I also want to calculate the seasonal detection probability of all my sites. Can anyone tell me what is the code?

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Seasonal Detection Probability
parts:
Dear Debashish,

it's like always in R, you must use the predict() function. For examples for colext(), please see Section 4.9 in the AHM2 book. You can download the code here: https://github.com/mikemeredith/AHM_code/tree/main/AHM2_ch04

Best regards  -- Marc
